content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD initialization source file (header L3 'FILE init.F', BSD license L5-43). SUBROUTINE ALLOCATE_VARIABLES (L54) allocates all GLOBAL arrays: coordinates Xco/Yco (L58); derivative arrays DelxU..DelyHU (L60-62); x/y interface L/R states UxL..HyR (L64-70); cross/second/first/time derivatives (L72-85); AB_OUTPUT grdAx..grdBy (L87); flux arrays PL..EtaRyR (L90-94); SPONGE/SpongeMaker (L96); state arrays Fx,Fy,U,V,HU,HV,Gx,Gy,P,Q,SxL..SourceY (L98-104); statistics Umean..SigWaveHeight (L106-138); dispersion U4xL..U4yR under CARTESIAN (L140-144) or ZALPHA (L147-151) plus spherical Dx,Dy,Coriolis,SlopeX/Y,Lat_theta (L153-155); depth/mask block (L158-164); updating vars Eta,Eta0,Ubar0,Vbar0,Ubar,Vbar (L166-168); EtaScreen (L171); dispersion updating U4..V3 (L175-184); ITERATION arrays (L187-188); HeightMax (L192), WaveMaker_Mass (L195); WK_TIME arrays WAVE_COMP,Beta_genS,D_genS (L199); breaking arrays AGE_BREAKING,nu_break,BreakSourceX/Y allocated unconditionally per fyshi 01/15/2024 change (L212-215); FrcInsX/Y (L218); ROLLER_FLUX,UNDERTOW_U/V (L220); conditional nu_break (L223), nu_sponge (L228), HeightMin/VelocityMax/VorticityMax/MomentumFluxMax/ARRTIME under OUT_* flags (L232-251); Salatin et al. 2021 wave-coherence wavemaker coordinates xmk_wk,ymk_wk (L264). SUBROUTINE INITIALIZATION (L280) uses GLOBAL, INPUT_READ, BATHY_CORRECTION_MODULE (L281-283): non-CARTESIAN grid setup — StretchGrid reads DX_FILE/DY_FILE/Coriolis_FILE (L310-330) with ghost-cell fill (L333-357), else computes spherical Dx=R_earth*Dphi_r*cos(lat), Dy=R_earth*Dtheta_r, Coriolis=pi*sin(lat)/21600 (L363-383); MUSCL Kappa by HIGH_ORDER 'SEC' (L389-393); zeroes all statistics/derivative/flux arrays (L396-561); builds Xco/Yco cumulative coordinates with parallel iista/jjsta offsets (L566-620); resets counters, DT=ZERO (L636); zeroes Gamma1/Gamma2 when Gamma3<=0 (linear SWE) or DISPERSION false (L638-654); sets Boussinesq coefficients a1,a2,b1,b2,Beta_1,Beta_2 from Beta_ref for CARTESIAN fully nonlinear (L658-664), or a1=a2=0,b1=1/3,b2=-1/2 for weakly nonlinear spherical Kirby et al. 2009 (L667-670) with ZALPHA override (L674-678); bathymetry: DEPTH_TYPE DAT reads DEPTH_FILE (L688-712), FLA constant Depth_FLat (L714-721), SLO flat+slope profile via Xslp/SLP (L725-777); SUBGRID_INITIAL (L780); ghost/interface depth via PHI_COLL with mirror BC (L789-794); BATHY_CORRECTION CORRECTION (L797-799); adds WaterLevel to Depth/DEP_WK/Dep_Ser (L803-807); reconstructs DepthX/DepthY interface averages and extrapolated edges (L811-829); blowup threshold EtaBlowVal=100*max|Depth| with MPI_ALLREDUCE (L847-850); friction Cd from CD_FILE or Cd_fixed (L854-890); initial conditions INI_UVZ/INITIAL_UVZ with BED_DEFORMATION depth adjustment (L895-904); wavemaker initial states INI_SOL/N_WAVE/INI_REC/INI_GAU/INI_DIP/INI_OTH (L907-960); WAVEMAKER_INITIALIZATION (L963); sponges DIRECT/DIFFUSION/FRICTION and ABS SpongeMaker (L966-996); initial mask from Eta<-Depth (L1000-1014); H=MAX(Eta*Gamma3+Depth,MinDepthFrc), HU=H*U, HV=H*V (L1016-1018); CAL_DISPERSION (L1021); Ubar=HU+gamma1*U1p*H (L1024-1025); OBSTACLE_FILE into MASK_STRUC (L1029-1058); BREAKWATER_FILE into BreakWaterWidth then CALCULATE_CD_BREAKWATER (L1061-1140); Depth=-LARGE at structures (L1143-1149); MASK=MASK*MASK_STRUC and 9-point MASK9 product (L1151-1159); PHI_INT_EXCH parallel exchange (L1162-1163); COUPLING_INITIAL (L1170); non-CARTESIAN slope arrays with hardwired SLOPE_CTR=.FALSE., MAX_SLOPE=0.1 cap (L1179-1194); depth flattening at masked cells unless IGNORE_BIG_SLOPE (L1207-1220); T_brk=20 if SHOW_BREAKING (L1222-1224); Salatin 2021 wavemaker index window ilo/ihi/jlo/jhi from xmk_wk/ymk_wk vs Xc_WK/Yc_WK (L1236-1268). SUBROUTINE INITIAL_UVZ (L1283) INQUIREs U_FILE/V_FILE/ETA_FILE existence (L1291-1328), reads U,V,ETA and optional MASK_FILE into rMASK via GetFile (PARALLEL, L1332-1343) or direct OPEN/READ over interior points (L1348-1376), MASK=INT(rMASK) or 1 (L1380-1384).

verbatim_spans.text: !    08/06/2015 Choi added V4xL, U4yL, V4xL, U4yL, WAVEMAKER_VIS
! define breaking related variables for all options,remove viscosity breaking only
!      gamma3 = 0 means linear shallow water equation
! for weakly nonlinear equations on sphere (kirby et al 2009)
! use mirror instead of continuous used before, date: 02/24/2019
! In Makefile, define -DIGNORE_BIG_SLOPE to ignore big slopes

unresolved: nu_break is ALLOCATEd unconditionally (L213, guard commented out L211/L216 per fyshi 01/15/2024) and ALLOCATEd again inside IF(WAVEMAKER_VIS) (L223) — if WAVEMAKER_VIS is true this is a second ALLOCATE of an already-allocated array; relation L213 vs L223.

Comment 'ELSE ! for stretch grid' (L361) labels the branch that runs when StretchGrid is FALSE (computed uniform spherical grid); the file-reading branch L308-359 is the actual stretch-grid path — inverted comment.

VarGlob is allocated (Mglob,Nglob) for DEPTH_TYPE=='SLO' (L726) but (Mloc,Nloc) 'use local here' for the obstacle GetFile (L1045); GetFile semantics for local- vs global-sized target not visible in this file.

PARALLEL breakwater path: only myid 0 reads and ghost-fills BreakWaterWidth (L1081-1104) with the array allocated at global size on all ranks (L1077); no broadcast appears before CALCULATE_CD_BREAKWATER (L1136) — distribution presumably inside that subroutine, external to this file.
Beta_2=(1.0_SP/5.0_SP)**2/1.0_SP (L664): trailing /1.0_SP is a no-op; also Beta_2 defined only in CARTESIAN branch while ZALPHA branch defines Beta_1 only (L678).
Local variable WHAT (L292) is declared but never used in INITIALIZATION.
INITIAL_UVZ declares its own FILE_EXIST (L1287) while INITIALIZATION relies on a FILE_EXIST not declared in this file (L688, presumably from GLOBAL) — same name, different scopes.
AGE_BREAKING zeroed only IF(SHOW_BREAKING) (L623-625) though allocated unconditionally (L212).
HeightMax comment says used 'not only in output but also meteo module' (L191); meteo linkage external to this file.
